about: Input to scripts/build-research.mjs for /research/shutdown-notice. For every entry of src/data/graveyard.ts: either `announced`, the day the vendor published the notice, with the page and a quote that is a row of ops/sources/evidence/research-shutdown-notice.json, or `note`, what the pages read say instead. The generator fails if a graveyard entry is missing here, if a quote is not in the evidence file, or if a graveyard milestone labelled as an announcement disagrees with `announced`. Pages were read on `readOn` through source-snapshot.yml (run logs deleted after reading) or directly where the host is reachable.

entries.note: Google's Google Health API page, read 2026-11-06, gives the end of support (September 30, 2026) and the turn-off (November 2, 2026) but no date for when either was announced.
Terra's widget documentation, read 2026-11-06, gives the planned deprecation date and a 3 September 2026 cut-off for new accounts, but not when the deprecation was announced.
Google's Fit page, read 2026-11-06, says the APIs will be deprecated in 2026; its May 1, 2024 date is when new sign-ups closed, not an announcement.
Google's migration guide lists it among the features with no replacement and dates the end only to 2026.
Google's migration guide lists both among the features with no direct replacement and dates the end only to 2026.

entries.how: Strava's changelog lists the removal under its entry of June 1, 2026.
entries.quote: and Club Admins endpoints will be removed on September 1, 2026

entries.note: Samsung's overview page, read 2026-11-06, dates the deprecation, not its announcement.
Oura's API V1 page, read 2026-11-06, dates the removal, not its announcement.
Oura's API specification, as quoted in the graveyard, dates the deprecation to December 2025 and gives no announcement date.
WHOOP's migration guide says v1 is no longer supported and gives no date.
Google's legacy-solution page and solutions guide, as quoted in the graveyard, date the upgrade and the end of support, not an announcement.
The package README says it is deprecated and gives no date.

entries.how: Strava's changelog lists the deprecation, with both dates, under its entry of October 1st, 2021.
entries.quote: The get running race and list races endpoints will start to return empty values starting October 15th, 2021, and will be removed completely by November 1st, 2021.

entries.note: The Internet Archive capture of the Moves developer site, read 2026-11-06, records the shutdown, not when it was announced.

entries.how: Google's blog post giving the retirement date is timestamped 6/24/2011 (Internet Archive capture of January 7, 2012).
